nodes.statement: In a separate finite-dimensional continuous-output comparison, fix s,delta in R and epsilon>=0. The copied prediction is y_C=(s+delta,s); the faithful common-source competitor ranges over y_S=(t,t) for every t in R. Use the fixed Euclidean norm and separately bounded errors ||n_C||_2,||n_S||_2<=epsilon. No probabilistic independence is needed. No unmodeled branch modifier or synchronizer is permitted in this comparison.

nodes.statement: Exact model gap is |delta|/sqrt(2); two-sided error balls disjoint if |delta|>2sqrt(2)epsilon.

nodes.statement: For an integer T>=0 and p in [0,1], the COMPLETE scored observation is the binary mismatch vector Z_1:T. Under the shared hypothesis it is the point mass at all-zero; under the copied hypothesis its entries are iid Bernoulli(p) under genuine resets. Priors are equal. Any additional observed variables must have the same conditional law on the no-mismatch event, or must be excluded from this claim.
nodes.scope: One fixed mismatch-only or explicitly equivalent complete observation experiment; common p and trial definition, independent resets, equal priors. The formula is not claimed for an arbitrary richer readout.

nodes.statement: After T independent reset trials TV=1-(1-p)^T and exact Bayes classification error=(1-p)^T/2; p=0 persists at 1/2.
